SELECT f.id, f.code, f.name, f.address, f.manager, f.status, f.remark, f.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_warehouse w WHERE w.factory_id = f.id AND w.deleted = 0) AS warehouseCount FROM org_factory f WHERE f.deleted = 0
AND (f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.name}, '%') OR f.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.name}, '%'))
AND f.status = #{q.status}
ORDER BY f.id DESC

SELECT w.id, w.code, w.name, w.manager, w.factory_id AS factoryId, f.name AS factoryName, w.status FROM base_warehouse w LEFT JOIN org_factory f ON f.id = w.factory_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.factory_id = #{factoryId} ORDER BY w.id
SELECT id, code, name, factory_id AS factoryId, status FROM base_warehouse WHERE id = #{warehouseId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_warehouse WHERE factory_id = #{factoryId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, w.code AS warehouseCode, w.name AS warehouseName, COUNT(s.id) AS materialCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS totalQty FROM base_warehouse w LEFT JOIN inv_stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.factory_id = #{factoryId} GROUP BY w.id, w.code, w.name ORDER BY w.id
